core_obligations: Unwind the diagonal: a test morphism into the square of the stack is a triple of two objects and an isomorphism of their images, and the pullback of the diagonal along it is the sheaf of isomorphisms lifting that map (proof lines 358-388)
First assertion: the resulting description exhibits the pullback as the fibre product of two algebraic spaces over a third, so the diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces (proof lines 385-389)

Second assertion: the isomorphism space of the two objects is locally of finite type over the test object, hence so is the right vertical arrow of the displayed square, and base change and composition permanence give local finite type of the left vertical arrow, which is what local finite type of the diagonal means (proof lines 390-401)
proof_roadmap: 把 Δ_f 沿 T → X ×_Y X 拉回：由 2-Yoneda，T-点即 (x, x', α: f(x) → f(x'))。
等式 (equation-diagonal) 说明拉回是 Isom_X(x,x') 与 Isom_Y(f(x),f(x')) 在 T 上的纤维积 ⇒ 可表示。
Isom_X(x,x') 在 T 上局部有限型 ⇒ 右垂直箭头局部有限型；由基变换与复合保持局部有限型得左垂直箭头局部有限型。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic stacks is representable by algebraic spaces and locally of finite type (author lemma at source lines 343-356, label lemma-properties-diagonal). The proof (source lines 358-402) unwinds what a test morphism into the square of the stack is, exhibits the pullback of the diagonal as a fibre product of the two isomorphism spaces and concludes representability, then obtains local finite type from the corresponding statement for isomorphism spaces together with base change and composition permanence (proof lines 358-401). The identification of the pullback with the fibre product of the isomorphism spaces is the content. H3.
